messages.content: Hello - I read the piece on connection pooling and had a follow-up question about pool sizing under bursty traffic.
Following up on my earlier note: we ended up settling on a smaller pool with a shorter idle timeout, which held up nicely.
One last thing - would you be open to a short call about the platform migration we are planning for the new year?
Enjoyed the write-up on Terraform module layout. Do you keep the module registry versioned separately from the root modules?
No organization to speak of here - I am writing in a personal capacity, and just wanted to say the examples were clear.
Could you point me at the acceptance suite for the agent catalogue? I would like to see how the specs are exercised end to end.
